ErrorType.description: The everyday-action error types in SPEC section 7.
ErrorType.title: ErrorType

ReplaySummary.description:
One kept replay, as a row of a person's replay library (SPEC section 17).

What `GET /people/{person_id}/replays` lists: enough to pick an attempt to look
at - when it was, how long it took, how many errors and of which kinds - without
carrying a single frame. The frames and the markers come one session at a time
(`Replay`).

person_id.description: Whose session it was. `Session.resident_id` under the name SPEC section 17 gives it: a person watches their own routine, supervisors look with them.
person_id.title: Person Id

duration_s.description: How long the attempt took, in seconds.
duration_s.title: Duration S

error_count.description: Errors found in the session, self-corrected ones included.
error_count.title: Error Count

error_types.description: Which kinds of error it had, each named once, in the order they happened.
error_types.title: Error Types

normal.description: This is the person's most recent session with no errors at all, kept as the comparison to look at the others against rather than because anything went wrong.
normal.title: Normal

ReplaySummary.title: ReplaySummary

description:
A person's replay library (`GET /people/{person_id}/replays`, SPEC section 17).

Every attempt of theirs that had an error and is still inside the retention
window, newest first, plus the one normal session kept beside them: SPEC section
17's "compare with the person's normal" needs something to compare against, and a
clean session is kept for that and not listed as one of the attempts to review.

replays.description: Their sessions that had at least one error, newest first, after any `type` and `since` filter.
replays.title: Replays

normal.description: Their most recent session with no errors, to compare the others against. Null until they have had one.

title: PersonReplays
